description: Cauchy distribution survival function 1/2 - atan(z) / pi, z = (x - mu) / b (location mu, scale b)

tolerance.reason: the mirror image of cauchy_cdf (Q(x) = F(2 mu - x)), with the same exact z and the same conditioning. 1e-13 as for the other functions; results below 2.2e-308 are judged relative to that number (conventions)

grid: the cauchy_cdf grid: (mu, b) in {(0, 1), (0, 2^-500), (0, 2^500), (-10, 1/4), (100, 8), (-2^1023, 2^1023)} x x = mu + b z for z = -40..40 step 1/4, z = +-{50, 100, 1e3, 1e4, 1e5, 1e8, 1e10, 1e15, 1e16, 1e17, 1e20, 1e50, 1e100, 1e300, 1e305, 1e308} and z = +-2^-30, +-2^-60, kept where x is an exact, finite double that is 0 or normal (so z = (x - mu) / b is exact); Q rounds to 1 below about z = -5.7e15 and is about 1 / (pi z) in the upper tail (subnormal from about z = 1.4e307)
